name: Image Generation
description: Create downloadable image artifacts through configured generation providers.

capabilities.description: Inspect resolved profile defaults, setup errors, configured providers and supported generation models.

generate.description: Generate image using the profile defaults and attach the result. No model selection is needed.
generate.progressive_guidance: Use this operation for ordinary requests. Core resolves the configured provider/model. Check capabilities to inspect resolved defaults or diagnose missing setup. Do not switch models after an error unless the owner requests it. For edits, pass reference_artifact_ids from this session. Do not claim completion without returned artifacts. Defaults live in this tool’s settings. provider=inherit follows the active conversation provider, model=auto uses its recommendation. If status is selection_required, explain the limitation and ask the owner to choose among choices; do not call another provider automatically. After they choose, use generateWithModel. Use configure only if they want the choice remembered.

options.description: Provider-specific options, e.g. voice, size, duration, reference images; document format; MiniMax audio mode=music.

reference_artifact_ids.description: Previously attached images from this session, for OpenAI/OpenRouter editing or reference generation.

generateWithModel.description: Generate image using an explicitly owner-requested provider and model. Use generate for ordinary requests.
generateWithModel.progressive_guidance: Use only when the owner explicitly requested a provider and model. Do not choose a model from memory or use this operation merely to bypass profile defaults. Check capabilities first. Use an output-capable model, not an input-only vision model. Reuse the owner’s configured account. Do not claim completion without returned artifacts. For OpenAI mainline models, use options.mode=hosted and optionally image_model to invoke their built-in image tool. For edits, pass reference_artifact_ids with OpenAI or OpenRouter. Provider-specific reference URLs can also be passed in options when supported.

options.description: Provider-specific options, e.g. voice, size, duration, reference images; document format; MiniMax audio mode=music.

reference_artifact_ids.description: Previously attached images from this session, for OpenAI/OpenRouter editing or reference generation.

configure.description: Save generation preferences only when the owner asks to remember/change them. Use inherit + auto to follow the conversation provider.
configure.progressive_guidance: Never save a provider switch without the owner's request. A pinned model requires its explicit provider. Credentials are reused from the provider account; do not request or store API keys here. Options replace saved output options.

model.description: Model ID, or auto for this provider's recommendation.

options.description: Default output parameters such as size/quality, duration/resolution, voice or document format.
